jobDescription:

ROLE:
This position will be responsible for driving sales and business development for the Enduron® range of crushing and screening equipment across mining customers in Eastern India. The role will focus on developing new business opportunities and expanding market presence across both greenfield projects and brownfield equipment replacement opportunities. In addition, the role will support identification of opportunities for ESCO® crusher liners for competitive equipment, leveraging the installed base of crushing and screening solutions. The position will own the complete sales cycle from enquiry generation through order closure and cash collection. Key responsibilities include territory development, tracking market competition and defining counter strategies, and working collaboratively with cross-functional teams to deliver timely execution and a positive customer experience. Plan and execute sales and promotional activities for comminution solutions, including crushing and screening equipment and ESCO® crusher liners. Generate and manage enquiries, ensuring timely follow-up and engagement with prospective customers. Support sales planning through accurate budget forecasting and contribute towards achieving assigned targets on a pro-rata basis. Prepare and present techno-commercial proposals in collaboration with internal teams. Lead techno-commercial discussions with customers and support order closure in line with business objectives. Work closely with cross-functional teams to support successful project execution, commissioning, and completion. Own the end-to-end sales process from quotation through order fulfillment and cash collection. Strong understanding of credit control, collections, customer reconciliations, and working capital management. Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP.
